pages.text: Heavy rain fell all night. By morning, all the water had drained out of the paddy.
Muddy water spread across the lower paddy. It seemed to be flowing from one spot.
"Let's fill it again," Dingding said. Grandma sat outside the house. "The rain has softened the soil. Stepping on it will break it even more."
Grandma folded her arms and waited while the water kept draining away.
Mom carried a shovel to the bank. "We need to block two places at once!"
She packed soil into one spot, then the other. Both places kept coming loose.
Water leaked from two places. Mom hurried back and forth. Grandma waited for the soil to firm up.
Dingding looked down at the muddy water and followed it back to where it began spreading.
There was a hole in the middle of the bank. "Here! Just this one spot!"
All three packed soil into that spot. The muddy water slowly cleared. The ducks played in the new pool.
